title_en: Stories of Modern China (18/20): Going Home to Write
note_en: Chinese expresses "can't" by putting 不 between a verb and its result or direction: 说不清楚 "can't explain clearly," 说不出来 "can't put into words," 离不开 "can't do without, can't leave." English needs a separate "can't," but in Chinese the 不 slips inside the verb phrase; with 得 instead (说得清楚) it means "can."
